eps.ov: Wang Ling and his comrades first hear of the legendary swordsman Fanrui, who can master the Celestial Style. Under the guidance of Mr. Wang, the students of the 60th school will learn new ways of wielding the sword.
Sun Rong fainted after falling victim to Wang Ling's flash of amnesia. Her grandfather is worried about her and sends her for a battery of medical exams.
Fanrui, the immortal swordsman, decided that Wang Ling would make an ideal successor. Unfortunately for him, Wang Ling has no intention of showing him his abilities.

The earth's crust is dotted with veins that supply the atmosphere with spiritual energy. What would happen if one of these veins was seriously damaged? Wang Ling and his friends are about to have the answer...

eps.t: Wang Ling's Art of Great Luck
eps.ov: Wang Ling decides to make a gift for Zhuo Yi. He goes shopping with his friends, who turn out to be easy prey for unscrupulous sellers. Will Wang Ling manage to save them from debt?
Wang Ling agreed to participate in the 60th school charity sale. To obtain items to sell, he will once again turn to the Ways.
After the failures of White Tiger and Azure Dragon, the 60th school will have to deal with the third of the Four Animals. Will the explosive Vermilion Bird be more skilled than his brothers in arms?

Black Turtle, the last member of the Four Animals, is determined to avenge his brothers. He is preparing to use an ancestral technique to attack the 60th school, whose students are preparing for the worst.
The Four Animals were actually more than four! The fifth member of this dangerous school decides to attack Sun Rong to avenge his classmates.
After borrowing a fraction of Wang Ling's strength, Sun Rong is now able to face Ocher Dragon. Will she manage to leave the spiritual dimension of which she is prisoner?

Taking advantage of a moment of inattention from the guardians, Chen Nanxuan finally managed to awaken to a Way. When he discovers that his disciples have been decimated in his absence, he decides to do everything possible to take revenge.

Yi Jianchuan finally faces Chen Nanxuan, more powerful than ever after awakening to a Way. Wang Ling's friends are convinced that they are attending an immersive theatrical performance, far from suspecting that the stakes of the fight are very real.
